assets.title: A house torn from its foundation in the Johnstown Flood, 1889
assets.creator: Unknown photographer, 1889
assets.license: Public domain in the United States
assets.credit: Photograph: public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
assets.depicts: A large wooden house stands tipped on its side amid flood debris in Johnstown, Pennsylvania, after the 1889 dam failure, with a massive tree trunk driven through its wall.
